title: Maximum Sum of Alternating Subsequence With Distance at Least K
summary: Maximize selected-value sum with adjacent chosen indices at least k apart and strict alternating comparisons. Singletons qualify.
officialConstraints: 1–100000 entries in 1–100000; k from 1 through n.
visualizationNotes: Fenwick visualization only draws up to 48 value coordinates; larger solver traces remain available.
